shadows.name: glass-navigation
shadows.purpose: Shared capsule depth and bright rim.

motion.name: control-ease
motion.purpose: Navigation 180ms and project 200ms transform transitions; fine-pointer hover only.

motion.name: control-press
motion.purpose: Navigation scale 0.97; project scale 0.975. Reduced motion removes transitions and transforms.

motion.name: intro-sequence
motion.purpose: Silent wordmark-to-eleven-media-tiles-to-shaded-crown sequence on every fresh page load. Shared Web Animations document-timeline origin; hidden tabs pause and resume.

motion.name: intro-fade
motion.purpose: Fade into the prepared hero after the sequence; Escape or reduced motion completes immediately.

motion.name: intro-settle
motion.purpose: Intro media collapse and crown-half assembly.

motion.name: intro-tagline-flip
motion.purpose: React Bits bottom-origin -90° flip in charcoal; 4800–6838ms on the shared intro clock, settled 200ms before the melt.

intro-wordmark.purpose: Plain ZANED in self-hosted Anton, 96px type with a 99px line box; identical static and animated glyph metrics.

intro-tagline.purpose: 32px Belleza, 40px line height, 0.005em tracking, charcoal #202629 throughout the flip and melt.

intro-suffix.purpose: 26px Space Grotesk 400, body color, 0.025em tracking. Separate from the plain Anton wordmark, beside D at its upper-right edge.

display.purpose: Self-hosted Anton 400 is intrinsically heavy and compressed. Natural uppercase glyphs, 1.04 leading, -0.015em tracking. Open substitute for Arizona Flare Compressed Bold.

body.purpose: Self-hosted Belleza 400, thin strokes and flared terminals, 1.45 leading, 0.005em tracking, 62ch measure capped at 44rem. Open substitute for Arizona Flare Regular/Light. Controls use Belleza 400 at 16px for navigation and 17px for the project label, with 1.35 leading and 0.005em tracking.

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Centered liquid-glass capsule retaining three enabled labels and 44px controls. Configured href values use native links. Preview shows the production frosted fallback with hover, focus, press, reduced motion, and solid fallback.

components.name: Intro wordmark
components.description: Plain ZANED in the existing self-hosted Anton display face, retaining the small Space Grotesk inc suffix.

narrative.overview: The supplied identity pairs dense, emphatic typography with open space, a lime-to-mist atmosphere, and original photographic cutouts. Heavy compressed headline type contrasts with thin, flared supporting copy. This record covers the shipped header and hero only; future surfaces have no established component language yet.
keyCharacteristics: Heavy display type and quiet supporting text.
Dark teal lettering over lime and mist.
Original imagery, static composition, and minimal controls.
Silent near-white intro: natural-width black wordmark, mixed-media tiles, and supplied shaded crown.

rules.name: The Type Pair Rule.
rules.body: Use Anton for the headline, Belleza for the description and controls, and Space Grotesk for the intro suffix.

rules.name: The Viewport Fit Rule.
rules.body: Keep this hero within one viewport without scrolling, including short desktop and compact mobile screens.

rules.name: The Glass Control Rule.
rules.body: Keep the material on the navigation and project capsule, preserving readable labels, visible keyboard focus, and solid fallbacks.

rules.name: The Natural Wordmark Rule.
rules.body: The intro uses plain ZANED in self-hosted Anton at 96px with a 99px line box. Static and animated glyphs share natural widths. The small inc suffix uses Space Grotesk beside D at its upper-right edge. The charcoal Belleza tagline settles 200ms before the hero melt.

rules.name: The Intro Handoff Rule.
rules.body: Keep the underlying hero inactive until the intro completes or is skipped; Escape and reduced motion must always reach the hero.

dos: **Do** preserve the natural text widths and supplied artwork proportions.
**Do** use the approved self-hosted type pair and retain the accessible heading name.
**Do** verify this hero at both narrow and short viewport sizes.
**Do** preserve natural intro letter proportions, uniform stage scaling, silent media, and poster fallbacks.
donts: **Don't** restore the removed lower profile artwork.
**Don't** disable unassigned preview controls; keep native buttons enabled with hover, focus, and press feedback, and render native links only when destinations exist.
**Don't** infer cards, fields, additional pages, or a motion system from this hero.
